title: Follow references that may be null

blocks.text: The default value of a reference is `null`, and following a `null` reference throws a `NullPointerException`. The page's advice is to check for `null` or to use `Optional`.
`Directory.Person` has an `address`, and `Directory.Address` has a `city`. Any of the three can be missing: the person itself, their address, or the address's city.
Write `Directory.cityOf(Person person)`. It returns the person's city, or `"Unknown"` when any link on the way is `null`.

cases.says: It returns the city of a person with a full address.
A null person gives "Unknown" instead of a NullPointerException.
A person with no address gives "Unknown".
An address with no city gives "Unknown", never null.

concepts: A reference defaults to null; guard it with a null check or Optional.
